crew.overview: The defense and the prosecution have rested and the jury is filing into the jury room to decide if a young Spanish-American is guilty or innocent of murdering his father. What begins as an open and shut case soon becomes a mini-drama of each of the jurors' prejudices and preconceptions about the trial, the accused, and each other.
crew.title: 12 Angry Men

details.biography: Steve Bono was born on 10 August 1923 in New York City, New York, USA. He was a production manager and producer, known for The One Man Jury (1978), The Undertaker (1988) and A Knife for the Ladies (1974). He died on 30 January 1994 in Chattanooga, Tennessee, USA.
details.name: Steve Bono
details.place_of_birth: New York City, New York, USA
